name: lendingclub-benchmark
description: A benchmarking dataset derived from LendingClub loan records for evaluating models that predict loan outcomes such as default or charge-off. It measures a model's ability to perform binary risk classification and rank borrowers by default probability using structured financial and borrower features. Commonly used to benchmark credit-risk models and feature engineering approaches.
reputation: The LendingClub dataset is a well-known public dataset in financial ML and credit-risk modeling with broad use in academic and practitioner experiments.
